svg.title: Z2 regulator-to-substrate attach
svg.desc: Cu pillar + solder cap + underfill; 1 V supply and return only; VDD/GND checkerboard
svg.text: Only the 1 V supply and its return cross here, about 1 kA in total; the 48 V input never does.
SCHEMATIC MAGNIFICATION — dimensions from the spec; 48 of the 300 µm TSV shown; pads and land-side RDL not resolved in the model
CLOSE_ANALOG TECHNOLOGY GEOMETRY — Au et al., ECTC 2016; not this package
Si substrate: VDD + GND TSVs, Ø30 µm at 60 µm, 1444 per cell
Cu pillar 14 µm tall, Ø15 µm, 30 µm pitch
solder cap 16 µm; underfill between the pillars
regulator 1 V output / attach RDL, 10 µm
• 3042 VDD + 3042 GND pillars per 2.37 mm cell (78 × 78 legal sites,
• ≈ 6.7 mA per pillar on average (1 kA / 49 cells / 3042): an output, never checked
• sparser published case (Ø30 µm at 80 µm): 421 + 420 per cell
Plan view, one cell's corner — checkerboard: site (i, j) is VDD if i + j is even; row A–A is the section
nominal: 15 µm diameter / 30 µm pitch (plan at 1/3 of the section scale)
